newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys Feb gasoline from Glencore at +$2.5/bbl.
newsitem.headline: India buys Feb gasoline from Glencore at +$2.5/bbl.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought through tender its third 25,000-tonne cargo of 87-octane leaded gasoline for February delivery from Swiss trader Glencore at around $2.50 per barrel over Singapore's 92-octane unleaded quotes, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender for February 21-25 delivery sought offers on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Goa and Kandla on the west coast by January 29 and was valid until January 31.
One source said there were not many offers made, but sellers had been very aggressive.
IOC's last gasoline purchase was much higher at $4.50-$5.00 per barrel over Singapore 92-octane unleaded gasoline quotes c-and-f basis, for February 15-29 delivery to Goa and Kandla.
